title: reel weird
pitch: a 60-second fishing run in a cursed pond. cast far for weirder stuff: a toaster, a shark in sunglasses, the cursed fish. fill the book.
controls: hold tap / click / space to charge, let go to cast. tap on the big bite. hold to reel, let go to ease. b opens the book, m mutes, p pauses.
how_to: hold to charge, let go to cast. farther = deeper = weirder.
small twitches are fakes. tap on the big bite (! appears).
hold to reel, let go before the tension hits the red.
catches in a row stack a streak multiplier (up to 3x).
today's rare is worth 2x. new book entries pay 1.5x.
